summary: ignore planfile and koru runtime state

delivery.outcome: Ignore .planfile/ and .koru/ runtime state directories in .gitignore, matching the sibling-repo convention (koru, repatch ignore the same generated paths) so daemon/index writes do not create pending-delta noise that blocks ticket allocation.
nonGoals: Do not untrack any tracked file (none exist under .planfile/ or .koru/).
Do not change product source under fixos/ or tests/.

architecture.decision: Root .gitignore gains .planfile/ and .koru/ entries adjacent to the existing generated-artefact ignores.

validation.evidence: Governance gate passes; .planfile/ and .koru/ no longer appear in git status.
